note: Tracy Content API: one row per collection of seed/site-model.json. type is page, article, service, project, shared or generic; urlPattern is the public path ({slug} for one entry per page), null when the collection has no page of its own. chrome names the shared entry the header and footer print. tools/content-api-gate.mjs refuses a collection of the model that has no row here. pages, posts, donations and events keep their own public path in the data field `path` (urlField): this template's article paths (`/blog/<slug>`, `/donations/<slug>`, `/events/<slug>`) are recorded in the data field `path` (ingest/bind-paths.mjs). Section collections have no page of their own.
